thread:
maggie: Huge shoutout to @ben for freeing my bike from the jammed bike-rack lock this morning " :pray:
omar: Ben to the rescue. I saw the contortionist moves. also thanks to Facilities for bringing the spare bolt cutters :muscle:
ben: happy to help! ended up being a seized padlock pin. one careful pry and we were golden. small triumph for urban cycling :biking_man:
facilities: we reseated the rack and lubricated the remaining locks so this doesn't happen again. left a note on rack: 'checked 8:45am' :wrench:
security: flagged to update the weekly maintenance checklist. also pinged the lost-and-found channel about an extra commuter helmet found nearby :shield:
maggie: extra thanks to @omar who lent me his cable while I waited. saved me a late Uber :raised_hands:
people-ops: We'll add Ben and Facilities to the kudos board and send a little thank-you snack box. DM me if you want to add a line to the note :mailbox_with_mail:
stickerbot: Sticker awarded: "Bike-lock Hero" to ben and facilities. :sparkles:
omar: mini poll: treat for the rescue heroes? react with :one: for espresso shots, :two: for bagels, :three: for empanadas
ben: :two: bagels please. and maybe some extra lube for the rack :sweat_smile:
people-ops: Bagels it is. I'll coordinate. thanks everyone for pitching in
